articles.title: Earth Was Built From Its Own Backyard, Scientists Say
articles.summary: Scientists thought Earth was partly built from stuff far past Jupiter. A new study says almost all of it came from right next door. They were 'truly astonished.'

articles.title: Three Red Panda Cubs Are the Star of This Panda Party
articles.summary: Three red panda cubs were born this summer at the Smithsonian's National Zoo. One is feisty and huff-quacks at keepers. Fewer than 10,000 red pandas remain in the wild.

articles.title: Orcas Are Smashing Sunfish Like Piñatas
articles.summary: Scientists filmed orcas slamming into sunfish hard enough to make them explode. One orca holds the fish; another smashes it. It may help feed young orcas — or just be fun.
